cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: Keeper! The Board wants a record. Not a good month; a record month. More vessels through the summit than any lock on the Meridian has ever passed. I have told them we shall do it. I have told them twice.

text_variants.text: Keeper! The Board has noticed the queue. It has noticed loudly. I have promised them the queue will be gone by the month's end and the summit will set a record clearing it. I have promised twice.

left.label: A record it is
left.outcome: "Magnificent!" He shakes your hand as if the record were already set.

right.label: Safely or not at all
right.outcome: "Safely. Yes. A safe record. The Board will not know the difference." It will.

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: A record month. I like records. My principals will send every barge they have to help you set it, on one condition: Sorrel boats first at every bell. Aldmere will complain. Aldmere always complains.

left.label: Sorrel first
left.outcome: Sorrel's fleet fills the pound. The record looks possible. Crane begins a document.

right.label: In arrival order, as ever
right.outcome: "Fine. Half my fleet, then. Records are for people who bend."

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: Day one of the record. Twenty-two vessels. Magnificent, but not enough. The Board has sent a man to count. He has a very small notebook and a very large watch. He does not speak.

left.label: Ignore the counter; work the gate
left.outcome: He counts. You work. Twenty-six on day two.

right.label: Feed the counter well
right.outcome: Ilse feeds him. He counts more slowly after lunch, and rounds up.

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: Inspections are costing you six vessels a day. Six. Waive them for the month. Crane will write to Aldmere. Aldmere will write to Ardent. Ardent will read it after the record is set and the Board is pleased.

left.label: Waive inspections
left.outcome: Six more a day. Crane inspects nothing and writes everything.

right.label: Inspections stand
right.outcome: "Then the record's Aldmere's to lose. Fine. I'll say I tried."

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: Two boats a filling. The Sorrel pattern. I know the Company forbids it. I have read the prohibition. It was written in Year 20 by a man who never saw a modern hull. I am not ordering you, Keeper. I am telling you what a record requires.

left.label: Two boats a filling
left.outcome: Doubled. The chamber is never empty. Hulls kiss on the third day.

right.label: One boat; it's a lock, not a mill
right.outcome: "A lock. Yes. I had forgotten, briefly, what it was."

cards.speaker: vane
cards.text: Halfway through the month and halfway to the record. My principals are thrilled. They've sent a gift for the hands: Sorrel beer, forty casks. Ilse is furious. The hands are not.

left.label: Let the hands have the casks
left.outcome: Forty casks. The hands work faster and sing. Ilse does not speak to you for a week.

right.label: Sell them through the inn
right.outcome: Ilse sells Sorrel beer at her prices, swearing. Everyone is nearly happy.

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: I have written to Aldmere. Formally. Under the Compact. The summit has passed ninety vessels without inspection this month, and the letter says so, with dates. I am showing you the letter before I send it. I need not.

left.label: Send it
left.outcome: "Duly." Aldmere protests to Ardent. Ardent is busy being pleased about the record.

right.label: Hold it until the month ends
right.outcome: "A week. I note that I am doing this, and that I should not."

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: I have inspected one vessel in twenty this month. In that one I found a crate of rifles under coal, unsealed. I have impounded it. I note that there were nineteen I did not inspect. I note that you know what that means.

left.label: Hold everything; inspect it all
left.outcome: The record dies in an afternoon. Crane finds two more crates. Pell is inconsolable.

right.label: Impound that one; the record continues
right.outcome: "One in twenty. Duly. I shall record the nineteen as a number, since I cannot record them as anything else."

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: The Sorrel agent has offered me a 'consideration' to delay my letter. I have refused. I am telling you because I have never been offered one before, and because she offered it in your name. She said you would want it delayed.

left.label: I did not
left.outcome: "I believed that. I note I am relieved." He sends the letter that hour.

right.label: I did
right.outcome: "Duly." He does not send it. He does not dine at the adjoining table again.

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: Night. Lamps on the gate, lamps on the boats, lamps on the towpath. The chamber has not been empty since dawn. A bargee asleep at his tiller goes through the gate on a boat steered by nobody.

left.label: Night passages stop tonight
left.outcome: The gate goes dark at the last bell. The record slows. Nobody drowns.

right.label: Post a hand on every boat
right.outcome: Company hands steer strangers' boats through the dark. It works. It should not.

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: Three days to the record and the pound is down four marks. The heavy barges are scraping. The hands have started to look at the gauge before they look at the queue.

left.label: Light drafts only, till the end
left.outcome: The record slips. The sills keep their stones.

right.label: Everything through; three days
right.outcome: Three days of scraping. A grain barge loses her rudder on the sill and blocks the chamber for a night.

cards.speaker: src_gate
cards.text: The last day. Dace has not slept. Quenn is inside the gear. Pell is on the dais with the Board's counter. The queue stretches out of sight. The chamber is filling with two boats in it, nose to tail, at speed.

left.label: Slow the filling
left.outcome: The boats rise gently. The record is missed by four. Pell sits down on the dais.

right.label: Full paddles
right.outcome: The boats rise fast. The rear one surges. There is a sound the whole town hears.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: A record, Keeper. A record! One hundred and forty-one vessels. The Board's counter has closed his small notebook and shaken my hand. Shaken it! There is a letter coming. I can feel the letter.

left.label: Take the credit
left.outcome: The letter comes. It names you first. Pell pretends not to mind, magnificently.

right.label: Give the credit to the hands
right.outcome: The letter names 'the summit'. Dace gets a bonus. Pell frames the envelope.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: No record. Close. Magnificently close. The Board's counter has written 'creditable effort', which the Board does not frame. I am not angry, Keeper. I am something. I shall find the word by Tuesday.

left.label: Next month
left.outcome: "Next month. Yes. There is always a next month, until the Board says otherwise."

right.label: The gate is sound; that is the record
right.outcome: "Sound. Yes. The Board does not count sound." He does, later, alone.

cards.speaker: pell
cards.text: Two vessels in the chamber. One under the other. Stroud is down there. The Board's counter has written one word in his small notebook and left for Ardent. The word was 'inquiry'. Keeper, I gave that order. Did I?

left.label: You did; I'll say so
left.outcome: You say so, to Kell, in writing. Pell is scolded for nine pages. Nobody hangs.

right.label: I gave it
right.outcome: "You did not. Magnificent. Foolish." The inquiry has a name to write, and it is yours.

cards.notes: Delayed from ma04_12 right. Right choice also cancels the Jubilee (ma01_15) if planned.
